Composition rights
The original composition and Ravel’s 1920 two-piano transcription are in the public domain in the United States. Inferred, not documented

First publication 1920; the maximum historical U.S. term has expired. This does not clear an unidentified modern edition or assert worldwide status.

Recording rights
Commons licenses the recording under CC BY-SA 2.0. Documented

The licence is reported from the source page, not inferred from the age of the composition. The upstream IMSLP record instead states EFF Open Audio License; both source statements are retained, and independent re-licensing authority has not been established.
